content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain why ATP is called the 'energy currency' of cells
Describe how ATP is made and used
Explain the advantages of ATP as an energy carrier

is the molecule that transfers energy within cells. It's made during respiration and used to power virtually all cellular processes. Understanding ATP helps explain how the energy from glucose is actually used by cells.
